about: What a message typed into the box becomes: answered as a chat turn, or run as a build (scripts/orchestrator/crucible_orchestrator/intent.py). 24 answers and 22 builds, the near misses among them: code asked for in the reply, a question about building something or about a build, a small edit to a file that is open. {"files": true} is a message sent with a project that has files in it. Run with crucible-routebench MODEL --decide tools/routes/answer-or-build.json; none of the worked examples in intent.py is one of these. intent.py's prompt was tuned on this set: answer-or-build-held-out.json was not.
